title: Disk space exhaustion on a persistent volume
description: The order-history-service Postgres PVC is at 99.4% of 100Gi and the database cannot write WAL segments, entering read-only recovery mode. The 99.4% figure and write failures are directly observed; the audit_log/WAL-retention growth attribution is inferred from a 14-day trend, not independently isolated here.
